command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "foreach (`$project in @('CampusNetwork-for-perf','CampusNetwork-for-perf_02','CampusNetwork-for-perf_04','CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09')) { `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/' + `$project + '/nodes'); Write-Output (`$project + '|' + `$r.Count); foreach (`$device in `$r) { if (`$device.name -eq 'SZ_Core' -or `$device.name -eq 'AGG_SW_02') { Write-Output (' has ' + `$device.name) } } }"
